sectiontype.name: zoe
sectiontype.description: A ZOE storage in this process: zoe.Storage. Each key has an environment variable, its twin. The twin is "ZOE_" and the key in upper case, with "_" for "-". The twin gives the value only when the section does not set the key. An empty value counts as not set. The twin takes the same values as the key. ZConfig gives each value as text, and zoe.config converts it, so that an empty value of any key reaches the twin.

key.name: path
key.description: The directory of the store. The storage creates it when it is missing. The section or ZOE_PATH must give it. A leading ~ is the home directory.

key.name: blob-dir
key.description: The directory of the blob files. The default is the blobs directory in path. A leading ~ is the home directory.

key.name: backend
key.description: The backend of the store. The only backend is redb, the default.

key.name: lock-timeout
key.description: The longest time that a vote waits for the lock of an object, in whole seconds, 0 or more, such as 10s or 2m. A longer wait raises ConflictError. The default is the default of the store.

key.name: early-locks
key.description: If true, an object of a class of early-lock-classes takes its early write-intent lock when its state loads (ADR 0045): a second writer waits for the lock, then reads the commit of the first one, so its vote has no conflict. The transaction sees such an object at a state newer than its snapshot, and every reader of it waits for the lock. The default is false: the locks come at the vote.

key.name: early-lock-classes
key.description: The hot classes of early-locks, each as module.name, separated by spaces or commas. A class that the structural merges (tier 1) merge raises an error: the lock hand-off serves it. Without it, early-locks on takes no lock.

key.name: read-only
key.description: If true, the storage refuses writes and does not create a missing directory. The default is false.

key.name: pack-gc
key.description: If false, a pack removes old revisions only, as the pack-gc of filestorage does: it keeps the newest revision of each object at or before the pack time, also when no reader can reach the object. An object whose newest revision is a deletion goes. The store does not record it. The default is true: a pack collects garbage.

key.name: compression
key.description: The compression of the records that the store writes: none, zstd or zstd:LEVEL. The default is none: the records are raw. zstd is zstd at level 3. A store reads every compression, so the key can change between opens.

key.name: structural-merges
key.description: The mode of the structural merges (tier 1) of each class that structural-merge-class does not name: on, the default, merges the conflicts of BTree buckets, sets and Length in the vote, or refuses them as BTrees does; shadow writes their result to the resolution log and resolves the conflict in Python as before; off does not run them. A shadow mode needs resolution-log.

multikey.name: structural-merge-class
multikey.description: The mode of one class of the structural merges, as CLASS MODE, such as BTrees.IOBTree.IOBucket shadow. The key comes once for each class. The twin takes CLASS=MODE pairs separated by commas.

key.name: posting-dicts
key.description: The mode of the posting-dict rule and the first-key rule of ADR 0042, two merges where ZODB's resolver refuses: on merges the posting dicts of ZCTextIndex entry by entry in the buckets with integer keys, and lets a delete of the first key through in a tree of one bucket; shadow writes the merge of the rules to the resolution log, then ends the conflict as off does; off, the default, does not run the rules. A shadow mode needs resolution-log.

key.name: resolution-log
key.description: A file of JSON lines, one for each result of the structural merges, with the user and the description of both transactions and the keys that it merged. The storage opens it in append mode and never syncs it. Without it, the storage writes no such line.

sectiontype.name: ssl
sectiontype.description: The TLS of a zoeclient section, with the keys of the ssl section of ZEO's clientstorage. The native client reads the files itself. ZEO's client gets the context that ZEO makes from them. A configuration that imports zoe and ZEO together has two section types named ssl, and ZConfig refuses it. In such a configuration, use a zoeclient section with native false and this ssl section in place of ZEO's clientstorage: it opens ZEO's client with the same TLS.

key.name: certificate
key.description: The PEM file of the certificate of the client. It holds the private key too when the key is not set.

key.name: key
key.description: The PEM file of the private key of the certificate.

key.name: password-function
key.description: The dotted name of a function that returns the password of the key. Only ZEO's client reads an encrypted key: the native client refuses this key.

key.name: authenticate
key.description: The PEM file or the directory of the CA certificates that the certificate of the server must chain to. In a directory, the native client reads every file. Without this key, the client uses the CA certificates of the system. Then keep check-hostname true: without the name check, any certificate that a CA of the system signed passes.

key.name: check-hostname
key.description: If true, the certificate of the server must be valid for the name of the server. The default is true.

key.name: server-hostname
key.description: The name of the server for TLS. The default is the host of the address.

sectiontype.name: zoeclient
sectiontype.description: A client of a ZOE server: zoe.zeo.ClientStorage, a subclass of ZEO.ClientStorage. It takes every key of the zeoclient section, with the same values, wait-timeout and native, and an ssl section. It declares the ZOE extensions to the server, and works as a zeoclient against a stock ZEO server.

key.name: wait-timeout
key.description: The longest wait for a connection to the server, in seconds, at the open and after a disconnection. A longer wait raises ClientDisconnected. The default is 30.

key.name: native
key.description: If true, the client runs on the native client, built on the Rust crate zoe-client, and not on the asyncio client of ZEO. Against a stock ZEO server, it needs msgpack true on the server. If false, the asyncio client of ZEO runs inside. Without the key, the client is native, but a stock ZEO server that speaks only the pickle protocol Z5 at the open, with wait, gives the asyncio client of ZEO inside.

key.name: early-locks
key.description: If true, an object of a class of early-lock-classes takes its early write-intent lock on the server when its state loads (ADR 0045), as in the zoe section. It needs the native client: with native false, the open raises an error. The default is false.

key.name: early-lock-classes
key.description: The hot classes of early-locks, each as module.name, separated by spaces or commas, as in the zoe section.

sectiontype.name: storage
sectiontype.description: A store that zoe serve serves under the name of the section, such as main for "<storage main>": a [storages.NAME] table of the configuration file of zoe serve.

key.name: path
key.description: The directory of the store. The server creates it when it is missing, except for a read-only store. A leading ~ is the home directory.

key.name: blob-dir
key.description: The directory of the blob files. The default is the blobs directory in path. A leading ~ is the home directory.

key.name: read-only
key.description: If true, the server serves this store for reads only.

key.name: pack-gc
key.description: If false, a pack of this store keeps the objects that no reader can reach, and removes old revisions only.

sectiontype.name: zoe-server
sectiontype.description: The settings of zoe serve. "python -m zoe.serve -C FILE" reads this section and runs the zoe binary with them. The keys other than binary are the options of zoe serve without "--", as in its configuration file, and take the syntax of the option. Each option has an environment variable, its twin. The twin gives the value only when the section does not set the key. An empty value counts as not set.

key.name: binary
key.description: The zoe binary to run. The default is ZOE_BINARY, else the zoe binary on the PATH.

key.name: path
key.description: The directory of the store of the storage name 1. A leading ~ is the home directory.

key.name: blob-dir
key.description: The directory of the blob files of the store of path. The default is the blobs directory in path. A leading ~ is the home directory.

key.name: listen
key.description: The address of the ZEO port, as HOST:PORT, or the path of a unix domain socket: a value with a / is a path, such as ./zeo.sock. A port of 0 takes a free port. The default is 127.0.0.1:8100.

key.name: admin-listen
key.description: The address of the admin port, as HOST:PORT. Without it, the server opens no admin port.

key.name: invalidation-queue-size
key.description: The most transactions that getInvalidations covers.

key.name: invalidation-age
key.description: Past invalidation-queue-size, getInvalidations also covers a tid younger than this, in whole seconds, such as 3600 or 1h, as the key invalidation-age of ZEO. 0, the default, turns it off.

key.name: client-queue-size
key.description: The most invalidations that wait for one client.

key.name: cache-size
key.description: The most bytes that the page cache of each store holds, such as 512MB or 1GB. The default is 1GB.

key.name: compression
key.description: The compression of the records that each store writes: none, zstd or zstd:LEVEL. The default is none: the records are raw. A store reads every compression.

key.name: lock-timeout
key.description: The longest time that a vote waits for the lock of an object, in whole seconds, such as 10s or 2m.

key.name: max-frame-size
key.description: The longest frame that a client can send, in bytes.

key.name: shutdown-timeout
key.description: The longest time that a stop on SIGTERM takes, in whole seconds.

key.name: idle-timeout
key.description: The longest time that a connection sends no frame, in whole seconds. 0 closes no idle connection.

key.name: blocking-threads
key.description: The number of threads that run the calls that read, for all the connections together. The default is the number of cores.

key.name: lock-warn
key.description: Log each lock held longer than this, in whole seconds. 0 logs no lock.

key.name: transaction-warn
key.description: Log each transaction open longer than this, in whole seconds. 0 logs no transaction.

key.name: log-format
key.description: The format of the log lines on stderr: text, or json for one JSON object on each line.

key.name: read-only
key.description: If true, the server serves every store for reads only. The default is false.

key.name: pack-gc
key.description: If false, a pack of each store keeps the objects that no reader can reach, and removes old revisions only. The default is true.

key.name: shared-blob-dir
key.description: If true, the server shares the blob directory of each store with its clients, and accepts storeBlobShared. The clients have the trust of the user of the server, as with ZEO. The default is false.

key.name: structural-merges
key.description: The mode of the structural merges (tier 1) of each class that structural-merge-class does not name: on, the default, shadow or off.

multikey.name: structural-merge-class
multikey.description: The mode of one class of the structural merges, as CLASS MODE, such as BTrees.IOBTree.IOBucket shadow. The key comes once for each class.

key.name: posting-dicts
key.description: The mode of the posting-dict rule and the first-key rule of ADR 0042: on, shadow or off, the default. A shadow mode needs resolution-log.

key.name: resolution-log
key.description: A file of JSON lines, one for each result of the structural merges. A leading ~ is the home directory.

key.name: tls-cert
key.description: The certificate chain of the server, as PEM. With tls-key, the ZEO port speaks TLS. A leading ~ is the home directory.

key.name: tls-key
key.description: The private key of tls-cert, as PEM. A leading ~ is the home directory.

key.name: tls-client-ca
key.description: The CA certificates of the clients, as PEM. The server then requires a client certificate that chains to one of them. A leading ~ is the home directory.

key.name: tls-read-only-client-ca
key.description: The CA certificates of the read-only clients, as PEM. The holder of a certificate that chains to one of them registers read-only only. A leading ~ is the home directory.

multisection.description: The named stores. The name of each section is its storage name.
